failure: Four-role C2+ failed with an unstructured hipBLASLt out-of-memory error during startup. This is not a validated capacity exclusion.
source_finding: The 144 selected FP8 LinearExecution objects each create a library handle after the authoritative free-memory snapshot and Program arena allocation.
decision: Preserve all successful, failed and partial outputs. Repair shared library-resource ownership and startup accounting, then use a fresh reviewed recovery package. Do not resume this namespace, reinterpret these errors as capacity exclusions, or launch its whole/select stages.
